description: Five training regimes from the team's proposal (R1-R5). Arms and analysis plan fixed on 2026-11-05 before any regime run.

preregistration.core_hypothesis: Under a fixed CNN, more writer diversity in training improves accuracy on unseen writers and lowers WriterBias.
preregistration.test: Unseen-writer accuracy and WriterBias (max-min over the 5 writers' held-out splits) as a function of k = number of training writers (1..4), in the full-data series (R2, R3) and in the size-matched series (R3s, ~1712 training images for every k). Supported if unseen accuracy rises and WriterBias falls with k in the size-matched series (Spearman rho over seed-level means, and k=1 vs k=4 paired by seed).
preregistration.rq2_size_sweep: Added 2026-11-05 before any regime run: R3 (k=3) and R4 at 10/25/50/100% of each training writer's split, baseline arm; report gap (acc, loss) and WriterBias vs fraction.
preregistration.rq2_equal_steps: Added 2026-11-05 after the first regime run, before these runs: the RQ2 size sweep repeated with epochs = round(5 / fraction) so each fraction gets the optimizer steps of the 100% run (R3fe, R4fe). Same metrics as rq2_size_sweep.
preregistration.rq4_finetune_sweep: Added 2026-11-05 before these runs: R5 fine-tuning with lr scale in {0.1, 0.3, 1.0} x epochs in {5, 15} (R5s; 0.1/5 is plain R5), baseline arm. Report MNIST forgetting vs unseen-writer gain over the scratch model.

amendments: 2026-11-06: added R1m (MNIST subsets of 1-4 writers worth of images, 5 seeds) after the main results, to test whether R1s advantage on unseen writers comes from MNIST writer diversity or its 35x size.
